title: Proof-of-Identity Uplift by Recovery Route — Late Resets
content:
# Proof-of-identity uplift

> Harborline Customer Accounts

The proof-of-identity uplift of the late-reset goodwill follows the approved request's evidence route, the recovery method on the recovery request record: government ID adds $3.00, PIN and card adds $1.50, and the email link adds nothing. The uplift is a fixed sum added to the late-reset goodwill figure.

| Recovery method of the approved request | Uplift |
|---|---|
| government ID | $3.00 |
| PIN and card | $1.50 |
| email link | nothing |
